note: What a server sends to carry a text to a client. It changes nothing a client shows. The header carries zero.

fields.name: length
fields.note: How many bytes of text follow. Zero, or a value above 2147483647, carries no text.

fields.name: text
fields.note: The text, with no terminating zero. A client looks each word up in its own text and writes the result a line at a time.
